training_statistics.coordinate_system: raw external teacher states; fixed internal shared affine normalization

cache_role: historical raw clean validation and heldout token identities
train_metric_definition: Post-update evaluation of the fixed first min(256, num_train_docs) training documents at the same checkpoint as validation; epoch 0 is initialization.
optimizer: Muon matrix weights x1.0 + Adam biases
learning_rate_definition: Adam bias base LR; every optimizer-group LR is logged

checkpoint_selection.population: shared canonical all-k live finite validation
checkpoint_selection.final: actual last epoch, independent of best selection

normalization.moments: CPU FP64 population mean/std (correction=0), per boundary and feature
normalization.sigma_floor_rule: per boundary max(1e-3 * median(feature population std), 1e-6)
normalization.state_objective: plain elementwise mean squared error in raw teacher residual coordinates
normalization.latent_objective: plain elementwise mean squared error; predicted and teacher encodings both trainable
normalization.multistart_objective: plain state/latent MSE over all later teacher-start/end pairs equally; fresh encoding at each start, no resets during propagation
normalization.finite_objective: mean nonempty (k,rho bucket,horizon) standardized SSE/target energy
normalization.finite_standardization: fixed shared global training_statistics.sigma, independent of student normalization

raw_metric_definitions.reconstruction_mse: summed raw input reconstruction SSE / (documents * hidden_width)
raw_metric_definitions.state_rollout_mse: summed raw rollout SSE / (documents * output_boundaries * hidden_width)
raw_metric_definitions.latent_mse: summed propagated-versus-encoded latent SSE / (documents * output_boundaries * latent_width)
raw_metric_definitions.fvu: summed SSE / (max(epoch-wide teacher variation around each feature mean, 0) + 1e-8)

evaluation.live_clean: val/finite_clean_*; never mixed with historical cache targets
evaluation.short_prefix: val/short_prefix_*; fixed saved validation tokens cropped to length 2..64
evaluation.finite_sampler: fixed document IDs; same P/rho/mix across arms independent of training k/weights
evaluation.finite_metrics: raw ratios of summed energies; standardized geometry explicitly suffixed _standardized
evaluation.finite_cosine: mean individual-response cosine; negligible/zero vector pairs excluded with defined fraction
evaluation.finite_norm_ratio: sqrt(sum predicted response energy / sum teacher response energy)
evaluation.finite_breakdown: output layer, injection k, rho bucket, and crossed layer/k/rho

gradient_diagnostics.sampling: fixed first training-probe batch BEFORE each epoch's optimizer updates; epoch0 initialization
gradient_diagnostics.sample_optimizer_step: global pre-update optimizer step, recorded as train/grad_sample_optimizer_step
gradient_diagnostics.raw_norms: all counterfactual objective-gradient L2 norms, including inactive terms
gradient_diagnostics.cosines: unweighted pairwise cosine, omitted only for zero-norm groups
gradient_diagnostics.groups: total, flow, operator, augmentation when present
gradient_diagnostics.combined_gradient: train/grad_norm_pre_clip: epoch mean combined norm on actual updates BEFORE clip
